name: Ecstatic Dance
address: 2nd Floor, 2 Gat Lebuh Chulia, 10300 George Town, Penang
description:
“Dance like no one is watching”

From Bali to New York and Barcelona, the power of ecstatic dance is spreading. It is an opportunity to ground ourselves and shake off the chaos of our daily lives. The rhythm takes over and we enter a meditative state, flowing through and relieving built up energies and emotions.

Ecstatic Ethos brings the pulse to Penang - building and releasing, creating a flow to get lost in.

Come dance with us - no phones, no judgment, no worries.

name: Picnic & Pool Party
address: 97 Jalan Batu Ferringhi, 11100 Batu Ferringhi, Penang
description:
SUN, SPLASH & GOOD VIBES!

Get ready for the Lone Pine Picnic & Pool Party!

Dive into an unforgettable evening of House & Disco beats, fun games, exciting prizes, a fabulous fashion show, and poolside vibes with DJ Shlant & Poison in Groove Worker!

Bring your friends, family & picnic crew for an afternoon of sunshine, music and memories!

addon.title: Picnic
addon.description:
Make it a proper picnic! Pre-order a poolside picnic set from Lone Pine Hotel and we'll have it ready for you at the party.

Show your picnic QR at the pool bar to collect your set.
